profile.headline: Software engineer, cloud engineer, and manager
profile.summary: Team lead working on transforming banking using the cloud. Love making stuff and continuing to learn.

positions.title: Vice President, Lead Software Engineer and Team Manager
Lecturer
positions.description: Taught several classes including Software Engineering, Introduction to Discrete Math, and Introduction to Programming with Python.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Hobnob magically creates beautiful, mobile-first invites with a layer of intelligence for a seamless experience across native app, mobile web and text so that you can focus on what matters most about an event: being there

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Migrated a large Django/Erlang project from Rackspace to Heroku. Mentored people new to Ruby on Rails and helped them learn about agile development.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Took over teaching duties for the second part-time cohort. Covered abstract topics such as data structures and algorithms. Mentored students as they worked on projects.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed an open source web framework for energy competitions using Django/Pinax that was used for a residence hall energy competition at the University of Hawaii at Manoa.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description: Worked with the Triple Helix Institute on a grant involving linking small specialized communities.  Involved maintenance of a web application based on Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Developed a GUI for a program that is run on their supercomputers.  Used HTML, CSS, and Javascript to interact with a SOAP API using Mozilla’s security model.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: Assistant in the Laboratory for Interactive Learning Technologies (http://lilt.ics.hawaii.edu).  Performed a data analysis of over 8000 users in a MySQL database for a second language learning website in Japan.  Fixed issues and implemented new features in a web application developed by our lab (http://discourse.ics.hawaii.edu) which is used by the department to host course content.  Created mobile applications using the iPhone SDK.

positions.title: Computer/Clerical Specialist I
positions.description: Worked with researchers in the College of Education’s Curriculum Research and Development Group (CRDG) to resolve computer issues.  Solved issues in Windows 2000/XP and Mac OS X.  Configured and installed computers for K-12 students and teachers at the University Laboratory School.  Helped set up audio/visual equipment for both classrooms and large functions.

projects.title: Redeem HI5
projects.description: A jQuery Mobile app for finding nearby recycling centers in Honolulu.

projects.title: Makahiki
projects.description: An Open Source "Serious Game" Engine for Sustainability.
